hero.description: Coloria delivers flawless interior and exterior painting for homes, apartments, and commercial spaces across West London. Master craftsmanship, dustless prep, and premium eco paints.

about.title: Excellence You Can Trust
about.description: We bring precision, craft, and care to every wall. Specialising in luxury residential decorating, period restorations, and commercial interiors across West London.

services.title: Professional Painting Services For Every Space
services.description: From single-room updates to full property renovations, our skilled trade team provides bespoke decorative solutions tailored to your requirements.

items.title: Villa & Residential Painting
items.description: Complete interior transformations, bespoke wall finishes, skirting, ceilings, and flawless architectural woodwork painting.

items.title: Building & Facade Decorating
items.description: Weather-resistant exterior masonry coating, heritage sash window restoration, and protective facade painting built to last UK winters.

items.title: Commercial & Office Fit-Outs
items.description: Flexible out-of-hours painting for offices, boutique shops, and hospitality venues, with fast turnaround and minimal disruption.

items.title: Specialist & Decorative Finishes
items.description: Bespoke feature walls, fine furniture lacquering, wallpaper hanging, and protective moisture-barrier coatings for kitchens & bathrooms.

projects.title: Our Painting Projects
projects.description: Explore our recent residential and commercial transformations completed to master decorator standards across London.

process.title: A Simple, Professional Painting Process
process.description: We take the stress out of decorating with an organised, transparent approach from initial survey to spotless handover.

steps.title: Consultation & Colour Survey
steps.description: We understand your vision, assess surfaces, review lighting and colour schemes, and supply a clear, itemised quote.

steps.title: Protection & Dustless Prep
steps.description: We mask flooring, cover furnishings with heavy-duty protection, and sand with HEPA dust-extraction systems.

steps.title: Precision Trade Application
steps.description: Our experienced decorators apply high-grade trade coatings with razor-sharp edges and uniform coverage.

steps.title: Inspection & Clean Handover
steps.description: We conduct a thorough final walkthrough together, vacuum the area, and leave you with touch-up paint pots.

trustedPartner.title: Your Trusted Partner for Professional Painting
trustedPartner.description: Choosing the right painting company makes all the difference. At Coloria, we combine skilled craftsmanship, premium materials, and a customer-first approach.

testimonials.title: What Our Clients Say About Coloria
testimonials.description: Read genuine feedback from West London homeowners and commercial property managers.

items.quote: Coloria completely revitalised our Victorian townhouse in Kensington. The prep work was immaculate and there wasn’t a single speck of paint on our hardwood floors. Outstanding attention to detail.
items.author: David Thompson

items.quote: The entire team was punctual, polite, and extremely skilled. They finished painting our 4-bedroom house two days ahead of schedule, and the sharp lines on the feature wall are truly perfection.
items.author: Emma Richardson

items.quote: We hired Coloria for our boutique office renovation in Chelsea. They worked over the weekend so we could open on Monday with zero downtime. Exceptional professionalism and competitive rates.
items.author: Sophia Patel

benefits.title: The Benefits of Choosing Coloria
benefits.description: We set the standard for high-end decorating with reliable timelines, premium finishes, and complete peace of mind.

items.title: Flawless Craftsmanship & Crisp Lines
items.description: Our master painters focus on microscopic surface prep, laser-straight edges, and uniform coverage that enhances any room.

items.title: Guaranteed Upfront Pricing
items.description: Detailed fixed-price estimates with comprehensive breakdowns. No hidden fees or surprise add-ons upon completion.

items.title: Long-Lasting Eco & Trade Materials
items.description: We specify ultra-durable, low-VOC washable emulsions and tough wood lacquers from leading British paint makers.

items.title: Spotless Daily Cleanliness
items.description: We respect your home with full protective masking, HEPA air scrubbers, and a thorough clean-up at the end of each day.

items.title: Fully Insured & 2-Year Guarantee
items.description: Full £5M public liability insurance and a written two-year guarantee covering all workmanship and peeling.
